title: Path-dependent Affine Processes
summary: We extend the classical theory of affine processes to a path-dependent setting by introducing path-dependent coefficients and provide analytic formulas for their Fourier--Laplace transform in terms of generalized Riccati-type equations. In the proposed framework, we define path-dependent affine processes through their exponential-affine Fourier--Laplace transform on the path space and establish a characterization theorem.
